notes: Done. Read the Archdiocese parish finder (archphila.org redirects to catholicchurchofphila.org, then /parish/ and the Philadelphia-North and Philadelphia-South vicariate pages, all pages). Parishes with a closing year in the Archdiocese title (for example 1902 to 2012) are treated as closed and not recorded, except St. Rita of Cascia Shrine, which was checked directly, and Mater Dolorosa, which is recorded as hide. Parishes A through D and St. Bridget, St. Gabriel and St. Paul were left to the other agent per the slice. Outside the city, not recorded: St. Joseph (Cheltenham) and Presentation B.V.M. (Cheltenham), both on the North list. Parish pages say 'last updated N months ago' with no date, so those are not treated as dated evidence; status is probably_active where the Mass schedule is current. Only the Archdiocese parish pages were read, not each parish's own website. Community programs were not shown on most parish pages. Food pantries and program names come from one archdiocese PDF (the July 3, 2026 Day of Service list, read directly after the fetch tool could not decode it) and from one search. That list names volunteer service sites, so it does not show whether a pantry is open to the public. Vicariate listing pages 2 and 3 are cited to their base URLs, which show page 1 only. Outside the city, not recorded: St. Joseph (Cheltenham) and Presentation B.V.M. (Cheltenham). Search results also named St. Vincent de Paul groups from a 2017 parish report, kept as leads only. Budget used: 2 of 2 searches and 58 of 60 fetches. An outside process moved this file to research/hold-running during the run and back again; this inbox copy is the complete one.
